Full-time/Part-time (min. 32h/w) | Dresden | Hybrid (regular mobile work possible)Do you have a passion for high-quality software development and clean, maintainable code?Are you excited about applying machine learning, image processing, and pattern recognition to develop innovative solutions for medical and diagnostic applications?Do you enjoy transforming complex data into intelligent algorithms while working at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and life sciences?Dive into our AI!Your tasks You will take algorithms from research into real-world applications:• You’ll explore new machine learning approaches for holographic microscopy.• You’ll help shape our device design together with our hardware and optics experts, ensuring that the device captures the data your algorithms need.• Together with our biomedical experts, you’ll plan how data is collected and annotated.• You’ll build in-house tools that support colleagues across the company with annotation, calibration, and analysis.• You’ll dive into the data to identify what is holding a model back, whether it’s the data, the optics, or the algorithm itself.• You’ll own your algorithms end to end: developing, documenting, rigorously testing, and optimizing them to run efficiently on our embedded devices.Our current focus is on improving our holographic microscopy-based devices, although spectrometry occasionally comes into play. TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in Germany. Founded in 1828, today it is a globally oriented, regionally anchored top university and focuses on the grand challenges of the 21st century. The **TRR404 “Next Generation Electronics With Active Devices in Three Dimensions [Active-3D]”** is a Collaborative Research Center/Transregio between TUD and Rheinisch-Westfälische Technische Hochschule Aachen (RWTH Aachen) funded by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft. jobs.description: About GFGlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors that enable AI at scale, from the cloud to the physical world. We partner closely with our customers to deliver differentiated, power-efficient, high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. Across our global footprint in the United States, Europe and Asia, our teams are solving complex challenges that shape the future of technology. At GF, you'll find the opportunity to make an impact, work with world-class talent and contribute to a more secure, sustainable future.Your JobIn semiconductor manufacturing, no processing machine runs continuously yielding the same results. Materials used in the machine can degrade over time, simple factors like –outside temperature can fluctuate, and high usage and low usage play a roll. For stable process results, specific machine settings and recipe parameters are tuned automatically or manually. This is an essential part of work for our process and equipment experts.As a PhD candidate, you will be looking differently at our machines and processes. You already have a scientist´s or an engineer´s view. You know and see the parameters available, regardless of current usage. There, your journey starts towards finding the optimal machine and process settings with as few as possible latest data points. Latest advances in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence indicate the possibility for improvements and will guide your research.The goal of this work shall be the summary and testing of state-of-the-art methods in real-world applications as well as development of new methods tailored to the needs of the semiconductor industry, so in this work Data Science approaches are to be developed to enable process experts to use ML and AI for machine and process tuning.   The contract for this position is set up for 3 years with the possibility to extend it by one additional year, if required. We are looking for a research associate who wants to take a coordinating role in a joint project with other partners from academia and industry and in aligning their research work to the requirements of later mass production. You will systematically document and present the results in regular reports. GF supports the publication of scientific results in leading journals and the protection of intellectual property by the submission of patents.   Required Qualifications- You have completed or are finalizing your Master Thesis in Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or a comparable research field.- Your passion is to use your scientific knowledge in a cross-functional team together with experts from other sciences and fields of engineering.- You have already developed your own software, but also have high technical understanding capabilities.- You have solid skills in Python and related Machine Learning libraries.- Wrangling and evaluating data is standard for you.- You know how to use state-of-the-art word processing software to document and communicate your results.- You have a high degree of independence and time flexibility and enjoy communication within global teams.- A good command of written and spoken English (C1) completes your profile.Preferred Qualifications- First insights into semiconductor fabrication processes, e.g. deposition, etching etc. are a plus.- Knowledge about state models, digital twins, predictive control or world models, and about control theory are a plus.- Knowledge of Cloud environments, e.g. AWS, is a plus. Start Date2027, 3 years contract with 40h/week work time.Information about our benefits you can find here: hierSchlagworte: Englisch, RF, HF, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309367/phd-on-predictive-process-machine-control (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309367/phd-on-predictive-process-machine-control#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenÜber GFGlobalFoundries (GF) ist ein führender Hersteller von Halbleitern, auf die sich die Welt zum Leben, Arbeiten und Vernetzen verlässt. jobs.description: Every breakthrough starts with an idea, and with people who truly understand technology.In this role, you will develop innovative integration concepts, drive forward technological solutions with a forward-looking mindset, and actively contribute to the further development of our Power MOSFET technologies. You will apply your technical expertise to explore new approaches together with your colleagues, solve complex challenges, and take our technology performance to the next level.As part of the Corporate Functions team, you will develop strategies, refine processes, and implement initiatives that sustainably contribute to our company's success.Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Develop and optimize complex integration concepts and process modules for Power MOSFET technologies, from initial ideas and simulation through to process qualification- Plan, conduct, and evaluate experiments to ensure targeted technology performance- Drive process development from initial concept through to final qualification- Continuously improve technologies to enhance process stability and increase yield- Ensure appropriate risk management for process changes while maintaining our high quality standards- Actively share knowledge across locations and international teams, including facilitating technical discussionsYour profileWith your strong analytical skills, you quickly identify the root causes of complex technical challenges and develop effective solutions. You combine in-depth technical expertise with curiosity, an innovative mindset, and the ability to share your knowledge with others. Working collaboratively as part of a team comes naturally to you, as does striving for technical excellence.Qualifications and skills to help you succeed- A university degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a comparable field- Ideally, professional experience in process integration- In-depth knowledge of semiconductor physics, process analytics, and the evaluation of technological interdependencies- Strong technical understanding and the motivation to thoroughly explore complex topics and develop innovative solutions- Willingness to travel occasionally- Excellent communication skills in both German and English#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/) and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/) at Infineon.Nicole Hippmann

jobs.description: Do you have deep technical expertise, a strong affinity for data and enjoy getting to the bottom of complex analytical challenges? In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with data-driven analysis to identify correlations across test and manufacturing data and derive targeted measures to optimize the quality and yield of our products.Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Analyze and correlate data from parametric tests, functional tests and manufacturing processes using advanced analytical methods and tools- Identify and perform in-depth analyses of yield detractors related to design, test and technology, and derive appropriate improvement measures- Optimize product yield and quality and evaluate manufacturing experiments in close collaboration with experts from different technical areas- Analyze new products and take ownership of yield performance during volume production, including wafer disposition following functional testing- Develop and apply digitalization methods to efficiently analyze and evaluate complex technical data- Contribute to international product development projects and regularly report on yield performance and analysis results to internal and external stakeholdersYour profileYou enjoy digging deep into technical challenges and complex data, identifying patterns and correlations, and systematically investigating issues to understand their root causes. You combine strong analytical skills and technical curiosity with a high affinity for data, computers and digital tools. At the same time, you communicate your findings effectively and enjoy collaborating with experts across different functions.Qualifications and skills to help you succeed- A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or a comparable technical discipline- At least 3–5 years of professional experience in the semiconductor industry, ideally in Product Engineering- Excellent Product Engineering expertise and experience in yield improvement, quality enhancement and physical failure analysis- Strong data affinity and analytical curiosity, with the motivation to dig deep into complex datasets and technical challenges and systematically investigate root causes- Experience in correlating different data sources and parameters, combined with strong computer and tool affinity- Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, as well as confident communication in both English and German#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/) and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/) at Infineon.Nicole Hippmann
